speaker: dvm
text: Good morning! You must be Biscuit's dad. I'm Doctor Patel. How's he been since last year?

speaker: client
text: Morning. He's been great, honestly. Eating well, lots of energy. He's three now, so he's calmed down a little.

speaker: dvm
text: That's lovely to hear. Any coughing, sneezing, vomiting or diarrhea? Any changes in drinking or peeing?

speaker: client
text: No, nothing like that. Maybe drinking a bit more in the summer when it was hot, but that's it.

speaker: dvm
text: That's normal with the heat. What is he eating at the moment, and how much?

speaker: client
text: He gets the large breed adult kibble, about two and a half cups twice a day, plus some treats. My kids definitely sneak him cheese.

speaker: dvm
text: Okay. Let's get him on the scale. He's thirty-two point four kilos today. Last year he was thirty point one, so he's put on a bit.

speaker: client
text: Oh, I didn't realize it was that much.

speaker: dvm
text: It creeps up. Let me examine him. His temperature is thirty-eight point six, and his heart rate is ninety-six. He's panting, so I can't count a resting respiratory rate.

speaker: dvm
text: Eyes and ears look clean. He has some mild tartar on his back teeth, I'd call it grade one, but his gums look healthy. Heart and lungs sound clear, no murmur.

speaker: dvm
text: His belly feels normal, and his lymph nodes are normal size. I'd score his body condition at six out of nine, so just a little overweight. You can feel his ribs, but there's a bit of padding.

speaker: client
text: Fair enough. What should we change?

speaker: dvm
text: I'd cut his kibble by about ten percent, so a little under two and a quarter cups twice a day, and count the cheese as part of his treats. Let's aim for around thirty kilos.

speaker: dvm
text: For vaccines today, he's due for his distemper parvo combination and his leptospirosis booster. His rabies was given last year and it's a three year vaccine, so he's not due for that.

speaker: client
text: Okay, go ahead with those.

speaker: dvm
text: We also ran his heartworm and tick disease test while you were waiting, and it came back negative, which is great.

speaker: dvm
text: Keep him on his monthly heartworm, flea and tick chew all year round. He's due for his next dose on the first.

speaker: client
text: Will do. Anything about his teeth?

speaker: dvm
text: Brushing a few times a week would really help. We don't need a dental cleaning yet, but we'll keep an eye on it next year.

speaker: dvm
text: His nails are a bit long, so the technician will trim them before you go. Otherwise, he looks fantastic. We'll see him in a year, or sooner if anything comes up.

speaker: client
text: Thanks, Doctor Patel.
